page_title: Comet Browser: a Personal AI Assistant

sources.entry: Comet Browser - The AI browser that acts as a personal assistant. Automate tasks, research the web, organize your email, and more with Comet. #freemium

summary.name: Comet Browser
summary.one_liner: Comet is a web browser from Perplexity that uses AI as a personal assistant to research, automate tasks, and handle email and shopping.
use_cases: Researching a topic across multiple news sources
Drafting email replies using your schedule
Creating a study plan from a syllabus
Shopping for products like office chairs
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Comet as a browser built around a built-in AI assistant that can carry out tasks for the user. Example prompts shown include comparing how news outlets cover a story, drafting an email reply that references a calendar, generating a week-long study plan from a syllabus, finding a chair to buy, and building a simple website. The page says the assistant can be delegated tasks such as managing inboxes, ordering groceries, tracking finances, and planning vacations. It is described as available on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android.
notable: AI assistant that performs multi-step tasks in the browser
caveats: Pricing tiers are not stated on the page; the 'freemium' label comes from the listing, not the page text
Page is mostly marketing with few concrete technical details about capabilities or limits
